mapper.select: -- 根据主体映射获取所有角色编码 SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0

, all_role_codes AS ( -- 根据主体映射获取所有角色编码 SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0) -- 最终关联权限表 SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_codes arc ON rp.role_code = arc.role_code JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE p.status = 1

SELECT ds.subject_type AS subjectType, ds.scope_type AS scopeType, CAST(ds.scope_subject_ids AS CHAR) AS scopeSubjectIds FROM data_scope_grant_table ds INNER JOIN all_subjects s ON ds.subject_type = s.sub_type AND ds.subject_id = s.sub_id WHERE ds.is_deleted = 0 AND ds.scope_resource_code = 'default'

, user_roles AS ( SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ), effective_role_policy AS ( SELECT rp.role_code, rp.policy_code, rp.priority, rp.condition_override, rp.action_override FROM role_policy rp JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT role_code FROM user_roles) ur ON ur.role_code = rp.role_code WHERE rp.is_deleted = 0 AND (rp.effective_from IS NULL OR rp.effective_from <= NOW()) AND (rp.effective_until IS NULL OR rp.effective_until >= NOW()) ), effective_policy_definition AS ( SELECT pd.policy_code, pd.policy_type, pd.condition_type, pd.condition_expression, pd.action_on_violation, CAST(pd.config AS CHAR) AS config, pd.priority FROM policy_definition pd WHERE pd.is_deleted = 0 AND pd.is_enabled = 1 AND (pd.effective_from IS NULL OR pd.effective_from <= NOW()) AND (pd.effective_until IS NULL OR pd.effective_until >= NOW()) ) SELECT epd.policy_code AS policyCode, epd.policy_type AS policyType, COALESCE(erp.action_override, epd.action_on_violation) AS finalAction, epd.condition_type AS conditionType, COALESCE(erp.condition_override, epd.condition_expression) AS finalConditionExpression, epd.config AS config FROM effective_role_policy erp JOIN effective_policy_definition epd ON epd.policy_code = erp.policy_code ORDER BY erp.priority, epd.priority, epd.policy_code
